name: Floema
user_notes: User supplied this reference and specifically requested animation analysis.

tokens.provenance: Firecrawl branding; sampled values not a complete design specification

elements.description: Small product/scene image tiles surround the central brand statement on a warm neutral field. Scrolling leaves the collage and brings a full-width urban project photograph and collection details into view.
elements.brand_fit: Design-led product brands with a broad catalogue and environmental context.
elements.adaptation: Keep central text clear, vary tile scale, then give each collection room in a large photographic section.
elements.reduced_motion: Source untested; choose an appropriate accessible fallback in the client build.

motion.start_state: Small product/scene image tiles surround the central brand statement on a warm neutral field.
motion.end_state: Scrolling leaves the collage and brings a full-width urban project photograph and collection details into view.
motion.scroll_relationship: Scroll handoff observed; exact tile depth/pointer interaction not isolated.
motion.repeat_reverse: Scrolling up returned to the collage.
motion.implementation_status: adaptation is a proposal, not verified source implementation
motion.evidence_actions: Loaded homepage; denied cookies; scrolled back to collage; scrolled down to Urban and emerging Nature image; compared settled states.

elements.description: Urban city photograph with collection label, descriptive copy and catalogue card. Outdoor landscape imagery rises beneath/overlaps the city image while the Urban information remains visible during the sampled handoff.
elements.brand_fit: Outdoor, architecture and place-based product brands.
elements.adaptation: Coordinate the image mask and text handoff explicitly; verify all intermediate states avoid unintended overlap.
elements.reduced_motion: Source untested; choose an appropriate accessible fallback in the client build.

motion.start_state: Urban city photograph with collection label, descriptive copy and catalogue card.
motion.end_state: Outdoor landscape imagery rises beneath/overlaps the city image while the Urban information remains visible during the sampled handoff.
motion.scroll_relationship: Layered transition visible after downward scroll; pin/scrub boundaries unmeasured.
motion.repeat_reverse: Reverse for this handoff not tested.
motion.implementation_status: adaptation is a proposal, not verified source implementation
motion.evidence_actions: Loaded homepage; denied cookies; scrolled back to collage; scrolled down to Urban and emerging Nature image; compared settled states.

caveats: Only the listed homepage states were inspected. Exact durations/easing, full hover behaviour and reduced-motion behaviour remain unverified.

review_coverage.recording: no video or persistent screenshots saved; browser action notes only

scroll_control.notes: Scroll-associated motion was sampled; interception of native wheel/touch/keyboard scrolling was not established.
